lines_of_business: Health benefit plans administered by Cigna Companies; varies by plan and state mandate: 'Coverage for bariatric surgery ... varies across plans and may be governed by state mandates'
sections_in_order: Coverage Policy (Adults: Initial, Reoperation/Revisional; Adolescents: Initial, Reoperation/Revisional; Adults and Adolescents: Other Conditions, Liver Biopsy/Upper Endoscopy)
criteria_location: Coverage Policy pp.2-8 of 111 only; criteria text followed by procedure/CPT tables. Pages 13-78 are evidence review; 80-110 references.
procedures_covered: Not medically necessary: GES, VNS; experimental: band-over-bypass, OAGB, balloons, TORe, aspiration, VBLOC, etc.

logic.top_level: pathways (Adult, Adolescent), each an ALL of [BMI EITHER, multidisciplinary evaluation ALL-of-4]; then a separate procedure-eligibility ANY list

k_of_n.quote: EITHER of the following: BMI ≥35 ... BMI 30-34.9 ... with at least one clinically significant obesity-related comorbidity

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Tables of procedures that are not medically necessary or experimental; no patient-level contraindications. Revision not MN for 'Inadequate weight loss due to individual noncompliance'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Separate Reoperation and Revisional sections for adults and adolescents: major complication path (no weight criteria) vs no-complication path requiring 'Weight loss failure ≥ two years' plus initial criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: at least one clinically significant obesity-related comorbidity, including but not limited to the following

Replacement of an adjustable silicone gastric band or separate or concurrent band removal and conversion to a second bariatric surgical procedure is considered medically necessary if there is evidence of band slippage or band component malfunction and the faulty component cannot be repaired
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'separate or concurrent' and 'conversion' scope unclear; nested conditions without bullets.
Catch-all not-medically-necessary clause overrides the preceding list for revision.

requirement_kinds.quote: BMI ≥35 kg/m2 (class 2 obesity) (BMI ≥27.5 kg/m2 in Asians- when ethnicity is confirmed by provider attestation)
BMI 30–34.9 kg/m2 ... with at least one clinically significant obesity-related comorbidity
poorly controlled hypertension (systolic blood pressure at least 140 mm Hg or diastolic ... 90 mm Hg or greater, despite optimal medical management)
unequivocal clearance for bariatric surgery by a mental health provider
a nutritional evaluation by a physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner or registered dietician
documentation of failure of weight loss by medical management
A thorough multidisciplinary evaluation within the previous 12 months
Weight loss failure ≥ two years following a previous bariatric surgical procedure

thresholds.quote: BMI ≥ 40 kg/m2 or ≥ 140% of the 95th percentile
systolic blood pressure at least 140 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure 90 mm Hg or greater

time_windows.quote: Weight loss failure ≥ two years following a previous bariatric surgical procedure

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Strong: each procedure row pairs open and laparoscopic CPT inside the criteria text; Coding Information repeats lists (pp.8-13).
codes.non_covered_code_lists: Yes: tables of not medically necessary and experimental procedures with CPT/HCPCS in the Coverage Policy.
